text:
You made a bionic gripper... now, make your prosthesis bionic!

Use the Class Portfolio to drag your Dataflow program from last time (but not the simulation!)

Make any changes you think you need to make it work with the servo. Here are two changes you will definitely have to make:

  • Change your sensor setting from "simulated EMG" to a a device (the block doesn't have to change)
  • Change your device from "gripper" to "servo" (this block doesn't have to change, either.

Hook everything up!

  • If you need to connect your prototype arm to your servo, do that!
  • Connect your servo to the microcontroller
  • Tape the electrodes to you or your partner and connect the wires
  • Connect the microcontroller to your computer, and turn it on (and make sure it's connected)

If your group members have different programs, try all of them to see the different ways they work, or which work best.

If something doesn't work properly, figure out how to fix it with your partner.

You might have to make some changes in your Dataflow program...

highlightedText.text: Remember: Make a plan, then make a change!

text: When you try your Dataflow program (or one that is the same as yours), work with your group to evaluate the strengths and challenges of your program.
